GeneratedResidentHome membership is one-time provenance for census transfer and later moves must not delete it or cause second allocation; no extra initialized flag. Registration digest owns same-source idempotency, changed geometry rejects; this is source manifest identity, not proof all source catalog admission. Scoped Removed transitions require former property/holding payload. Materialization selects available aggregate property without relabeling original aggregate household to named household; aggregate remainder and named membership differ, no ordinary household ownership corruption asserted.
